reviews.text: Kim is the best with my dog! She is so gentle, I think he loves her more than me!

We have Rachel walk our fur babies and I can’t recommend her enough! Saying she’s AMAZING is an understatement. The boys love her and so do we!! She goes above and beyond and leaves the best post walk reports. Truly they make my day. I’m so happy I found this service and couldn’t have asked for a better experience!

We've been using Wag the Dog for about a year now and we love them! Our dog is reactive and Steph took the time to work with me and found the best person on her staff to fit our needs. Our pup loves Ms Kim and looks forward to his walks with her everytime we book!
wonderful dog walking service! super nice folks, easy scheduling, and loving care for our pup!
Great experience and loved the details after each walk. Pearl is little difficult with strangers so had issues when we had turnover with walkers for her to get used to a new person.
Great team of walkers/sitters! They’ve been helping us with our dogs for a couple years now. Always responsive and flexible.
My dog loves her walkers! They do the best job and show her so much love. She gets excited to see them and she’s always well taken care of.
The walkers are all so friendly, reliable and the pricing is very reasonable. They are very responsive and take great care of our pets.
Great products! Well made. Go for it!

Wag The Dog is our absolute favorite for pet care – they’ve been amazing with both our dog and our cat! Our pup Liberty Belle lives for her overnight stays, and we look forward to the fun daily updates they send. Our cat gets daily visits too, and we love receiving adorable photos and sweet updates that brighten our day. They truly treat our pets like family!

Had a great experience! Communication through the app was super easy, and I really appreciated the detailed notes and fun photos. You can always tell when your cat’s been well cared for…mine was totally relaxed when I got home. It was clear he really liked Kimberly (our cat sitter) was well-fed, comfortable, spoiled with treats, and had good company. Highly recommend!
We love wag the dog! Rory always does an amazing job with our reactive pup, Odie. So grateful for their services.

I used Wag the Dog as a service for my Weimaraner a few years ago when I lived in the Fishtown area. It was always such a pleasure working with Stephanie and her team. I never worried once about Zelda when in their care. Her team was always reliable, exceptionally kind, and flexible whenever our schedules ebbed and flowed. Would 100% recommend.
Steph and her team are fantastic, always reliable and take care of my pup with love. Can't give them enough praise and will continue to use this to pup sit.

I used Wag the dog for dog walking services during the last 7 months of my dog, Apollo’s life as he needed more outside breaks to not have accidents in the house and I actually wished I used their services a lot earlier. I was an avid walker with him daily for long walks but he was an absolute ham and loved the attention they gave him. They were so sweet to him especially towards the end when it was obvious to me he needed to be relieved of his pain. I’m so thankful they were there to give him extra love and attention. It’s been two years and I’m still so thankful.

Saying that we love Wag the Dog is an understatement! Our little guy Omar is 15 years old and has some separation anxiety – but he loves Steph so much that he pulls towards her building every time we're on a walk. We're very particular about where we leave our little guy, especially now that he's older, and Wag the Dog is above and beyond what we could hope for in every respect. He comes home calm, happy, and rested. He eats all of his food when he's over Steph's, too, which is a big deal because in the past at other boarders, he wouldn't eat much while we were gone. It means so much to us that we have a place to bring him when we're traveling. Steph is incredibly accommodating, flexible, and caring. We've gotten to know her as a friend around the neighborhood and we trust her completely with my furry son. Thank you, Steph and team, for the service you provide! It's not just love and care for dogs but also peace of mind for dog parents. We're forever (furever??) customers :)

I had a really great experience with the Wag the Dog team! I’ve used a few dog walkers in the Fishtown/ Kensington area and Wag the Dog was the most accommodating, most affordable price and the best scheduling/communication interface.

I've used Wag the Dog a few times now and have consistently been happy with the experience. The photo updates gave us real peace of mind while we were away. The team is reliable, friendly, and clearly cares about the pets they look after. I plan to use WTG again in the future.
Very grateful to have found Wag the Dog when we first moved. Love them!

We've used Wag The Dog multiple times for daily walks and have had a wonderful experience every time. Their walkers are true animal lovers and that makes a huge difference when you're trusting someone to help care for your four legged family member.

I've been using Wag the Dog for at least a year. They are the sweetest team and both my pups adore them. These pups are complex dudes and each and every walker does splendidly with them. The app is SO easy to use for booking and for communication and every walk comes with pics, a recap and notes on what kinda business was done. I cannot recommend them MORE. Thank you Wag the Dog team :)
Always on time, always a slightly longer than paid for walk, always a happy dog
They've been walking our two saluki mixes for a few years and are always very attentive, quick to respond, and overall great people. Couldn't recommend more!
Great service. Stephanie is the best. My dog always has a blast with her. He told me so.

Have been using wag the dog for years and cannot recommend them enough. They’re always so kind and patient with my senior pug and I trust that they’re always on time and treat my buddy with love. I’ve done walks, boarding and always been really pleased.
Excellent service with a holistic approach, holding the needs of the animals and their people, as the highest priority.
I've been using Steph and her crew for about 15 years now, and I always know my pups are in the best hands. I love getting the photos too, proof that my boy is not only safe but HAPPY!
I highly recommend Wag. The walkers are very reliable and experienced. They’ve been extremely flexible with my chaotic schedule and helped me in last minute situations.

Been with Wag the dog for 9 years. They have taken great care of our boxer from long stay overs when we travel to short notice 30 min walks when work travel changed. Very accommodative and communication over app is streamlined well.

They share photos and provide any strange behavior they might see with our dogs bathroom habits. Have recommended them to coworker who has had swell results as well.

Steph's team at Wag the Dog are truly exceptional. I absolutely delight in seeing the pictures and reading the comments that they regularly send me whenever I engage their services to walk my dog Chewy.

We've used Wag the Dog ever since we adopted our pup 2 years ago. They're reliable, professional and super easy to schedule (esp. important since our office days vary week to week). It's such a load off our mind to know that our dog is well cared for and you can tell he enjoys his walks and visits with his main walker and BFF, Keishla. Would highly recommend!

I have been using Wag the Dog for my pup Stuart for alittle over a year and I couldn't be happier with the service.  I feel no stress knowing that someone will be there twice a day to check on him.  His walker has really established a bond with him and he looks forward to the days that she comes.  The service is exceptionally thorough and dependable and even flexible if something comes up in the schedule - they have always been able to handle my requests.  The app they use is really convenient and user friendly.  And they provide a detailed update after each visit with pictures which I really appreciate.  I would not hesitate to recommend Wag the Dog for anyone looking for dog walking services.  They go the extra mile to make sure my pup Stuart is well cared for when I am not there!
Kim has been taking care of my cats while I travel for years now. Always know they’re well cared for and loved while I’m away.

I’ve been using Wag the Dog for about a year and couldn’t be happier! My dog is walked daily, usually by Rory and sometimes by Lindsay. Both are fantastic! I have a stubborn Shiba Inu who can take a while to warm up to people, but she took to both of them quickly. They are also very accommodating to schedule changes - they are great at finding coverage for last minute requests and have never given me a tough time about cancelling if something comes up. I really appreciate everything wag the dog has done for my Eevee!

Wag the dog has been phenomenal! We moved from a different neighborhood and were no longer covered by our dog walker of 8+ years. Happened to find wag the dog and 4 years later, still going strong. I love that we have a regular walker that our pups have gotten used to but in the event he is out of town or off there’s a regular backup walker for us (who we have also gotten to know at this point). Plus their communication is top notch whenever it is necessary.
Amazing company! Was so good with my little psycho rescue!

We use Wag the Dog regularly for walks for our two dogs during the day, and we love their services! The walkers are reliable and on time, and our dogs are always happy when we get back home. We also love the pictures and updates that we get after the walks! Also their prices are reasonable for the services they provide. Definitely recommend

Five stars isn’t enough for Wag the Dog! We’ve been boarding our floppy bundle of love here for years, and they’re hands-down one of my favorite services in Philadelphia. The team is reliable and caring. Prices are super reasonable, and the folks who run it are just solid, kind-hearted humans. If you love your dog, send them to Wag the Dog. They’ll be in excellent hands—possibly getting more attention than they do at home.

As a former dog walker myself, I was nervous to hire a service for my puppy Norma. I didn’t need to be—Wag the dog & Pam have been FANTASTIC! Responsible, reliable, always on time, and caring with my sweet baby. I’m so glad I found them!

Wag the Dog is the best- our dog Lucy is obsessed with her regular walker Kim and they are so easy to communicate with! They’ve been also able to help us out last minute when we’ve been in a pinch. We love knowing that our pup is in good …
Steph and her team are very friendly, professional and so loving to my cats. My neighbors use their dog walking services as well and love them. I would highly recommend their small business!

My dogs are reactive and a handful to walk. One is old, and his middle name is “death to skateboarders.” The other is young and 70lbs of pure muscle, whose middle name is “death to cyclists.” Wag the Dog’s walkers, however, handle them both with safety, care, and ease. They’re the ones I trust!

Wag the Dog is hands down the best dog walking and dog sitting company in PA. Stephanie and her staff have been reliable and kind. Scooter and Peanut just love their overnight stays and walks throughout the week! I would give 10/5 stars of possible!💙💙💙 …
Thanks we just love that smoosh face !
